description: Found by the fz-kdt.86 adversarial review (2026-08-31, cosmetic): when a callee's contract is PRESENT, keying facts absent, and contract application would raise FatalError (contract violation), base errored immediately; post-d5d45a074 the bundled ask registers keying waits first (jobs/semantic.rs require_callee_prerequisites), spawns Recursive/DispatchMask producer demand, and errors only after the wake -- one wake of delay plus wasted producer work on a drive that dies anyway. Fix shape: apply the already-present contract (or at least its arity/violation check) before registering the keying half when the contract is present. Low priority; diagnosis-latency only, no soundness issue.
title: Doomed callsites diagnose one wake late: keying waits registered before a contract violation raises
